bio: Glenapp is a magnificently restored Scottish Baronial Castle, with period furnishings and interiors, nestled in 36 acres of glorious gardens, on the rugged Ayrshire coast at Ballantrae.  Enjoy a delicious Afternoon Tea in the Castle Dining room, with views over the Italian garden designed by the Gertrude Jekyll.  Afternoon Tea is served every day and costs £45 per person, or £59.50 with a glass of Champagne. A children's Afternoon Tea menu is also available, priced from £19.50 per child.
